data.title: 春原瞬 · 教室课后的温柔摸头指引
data.description: 梅花园空无一人的明亮教室，黄昏斜阳洒在整齐的课桌上。瞬教官立于老师桌旁，丰腴修长的身段在斜光下轮廓迷人。看到疲惫揉捏眉心的老师，她心疼地俯下身子，伸出柔弱无骨的温热玉手轻抚老师头顶，绿色眼眸满溢着让人卸下所有重担的宠溺关怀。
data.location: warm sunlit classroom after hours beside desk
data.action: leaning down, reaching out hand for gentle headpat, deeply caring expression
data.lighting: warm golden sunset brilliance streaming through classroom windows
data.mood: profound maternal affection, soothing comfort, and doting warmth
data.promptProse: Leaning over the desk in an empty sunset classroom, Sunohara Shun reaches out with a tender maternal hand to stroke hair, her green eyes shining with pure affectionate comfort.
data.animaCaption: Shun reaching out tenderly with an affectionate maternal gaze in the classroom.
